newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain had 1996 State deficit of 3.3 pct/GDP. [CORRECTED 13:52 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Spain had 1996 State deficit of 3.3 pct/GDP. [CORRECTED 13:52 GMT]

text.p: The Economy Ministry said on Friday that Spain's state 1996 deficit was 3.3 pct of gross domestic product on a National account basis.
This was lower than the initial government target of 3.5 percent of GDP and represented a 2.1 percent fall over 1995.

The deficit on a cash basis, which is influenced this year by extraordinary items, rose to 3.68 trillion (corrects from billion) pesetas. Excluding those special factors, the cash deficit would have declined by 2.7 percent in December 1996 over the year-ago month.
The figure relevant for Maastricht is National account one.
